text.answer: Kled fights mounted on Skaarl, using a tether, dashes and rapid attacks to stay on enemies. His attacks and basic abilities deal physical damage with AD scaling; his charge deals magic damage, and fighting while dismounted can bring Skaarl back.
text.counterplay: Break away from his tether and rapid attacks; limit his opportunities to fight back toward a remount.

text.answer: Skaarl takes damage for mounted Kled; when her health runs out, he dismounts, cleanses crowd control and briefly becomes untargetable. Dismounted Kled gains speed toward visible enemy champions and bonus resistances; champion attacks and Pocket Pistol hits build Courage toward a remount that restores some of Skaarl's health. His Q becomes Pocket Pistol, while E and R are unavailable; remounting resets mounted Q and E.
text.counterplay: Avoid spending key attacks into his dismount transition; deny close combat when his Courage is building.

text.counterplay: Avoid the opening dash; if marked, keep creating distance and account for his return dash across terrain.
